name: stablecoin_reserve_shortfall
question_template: A fictional stablecoin issuer has {TOKENS} tokens outstanding, each redeemable at exactly 1 USD. A local reserve regulation requires liquid reserves equal to r={RESERVE_PCT} percent of the outstanding redemption value. The issuer currently holds {HELD} USD of eligible reserves. Use exact arithmetic. What is the signed reserve shortfall in USD, defined as required reserves minus held reserves (negative means a surplus)?
program:
def solve():
    tokens = P["TOKENS"]
    r = P["RESERVE_PCT"]
    held = P["HELD"]
    outstanding_value = tokens * 1
    required = outstanding_value * r / 100
    shortfall = required - held
    return {"final": shortfall, "required_reserve_trace": required}
